notes.title: Upgrade to Enjoyment
notes.content:
[b]-[/b] You can adjust the [b]keyboard settings[/b] from the "Settings" section of the game.

[b]-[/b] Enemies now have a [b]health bar[/b] on them, giving you convenience.

[b]-[/b] Added a setting so you can [b]sync to the monitor's FPS.[/b]

[b]-[/b] When you win the war, you will be able to see the[b] level screen[/b] with more beautiful visuals.

[b]-[/b] Many conveniences have been made in the appearance of the save screen, the equip screen, the 
skill screen and the [b]main menu[/b].
